synthesis.headline: Management dropped key margin guidance promises despite strong revenue growth and improving operating metrics.

points.text: Management abandoned its 11-13% long-term and 12-14% near-to-mid term company-wide EBITDA margin guidance after dropping them from earnings calls.
Annual revenue grew consistently from ₹8,792.0 crore in Mar 2021 to ₹28,884.0 crore in Mar 2026, while quarterly revenue reached ₹9,899.0 crore in Sep 2026.
Operations generate strong cash flow, with Mar 2026 CFO reaching ₹3,811.0 crore (CFO/PAT 1.41) and working capital days improving from 58 to 30 days.
Most segment targets—including FMEG, Wires and Cables, EPC, and export shares—remain unverifiable due to a lack of disclosed segment reporting.

bull.text: Annual operating margins remained robust at 13.9% for Mar 2026, supported by high ROCE of 33.0%.
Balance sheet leverage is extremely low with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02 and borrowings of just ₹272.0 crore.
Cash conversion cycle compressed significantly to 39.0 days in Sep 2026 from 65.0 days previously.

bear.text: Management stopped communicating near-term and long-term EBITDA margin targets, dropping them on recent earnings calls.
Debtor days stretched to 48.0 days as of Sep 2026 compared to 32.0 days in the prior period.
Quarterly operating margins show volatility, dropping from a peak of 15.8% in Sep 2025 to 12.7% in Dec 2025.
